verdict.rationale: Highnote provides auth-time controls you can use against fraud: collaborative authorization lets you approve or decline in real time with your own logic, and spend rules and velocity controls are evaluated at authorization. Its in-house operations team handles transaction monitoring, and configurable webhooks could carry alerts. However, nothing in the evidence describes fraud scoring, dedicated suspicious-activity alerts, or block-and-reissue tooling. Missing for 10: network or in-house fraud scores surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerting, card block/freeze and reissue tooling for compromised cards, independent corroboration.
